\section[(dialogue)]{Food, work and school — a first pass}

\label{lesson:PT-R113-first-pass-food-work-and-school}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for homework and a problem.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a blouse, a suit, a shark, thunder, lightning
  \item beef, vegetables, a mushroom, a cucumber, a strawberry
  \item a cherry, a melon, garlic, chocolate, a biscuit
  \item a sandwich, a sauce, vinegar, a dessert, a meal
  \item a yoghurt, ice cream, a steak, ham, juice
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A blouse? (\textbf{a blusa}.) A suit? (\textbf{o fato}.) A shark? (\textbf{o tubarão}.) Thunder? (\textbf{o trovão}.) Lightning? (\textbf{o relâmpago}.) Beef? (\textbf{a carne de vaca}.) Vegetables? (\textbf{os legumes}.) A mushroom? (\textbf{o cogumelo}.) A cucumber? (\textbf{o pepino}.) A strawberry? (\textbf{o morango}.) A cherry? (\textbf{a cereja}.) A melon? (\textbf{o melão}.) Garlic? (\textbf{o alho}.) Chocolate? (\textbf{o chocolate}.) A biscuit? (\textbf{a bolacha}.) A sandwich? (\textbf{a sandes}.) A sauce? (\textbf{o molho}.) Vinegar? (\textbf{o vinagre}.) A dessert? (\textbf{a sobremesa}.) A meal? (\textbf{a refeição}.) A yoghurt? (\textbf{o iogurte}.) Ice cream? (\textbf{o gelado}.) A steak? (\textbf{o bife}.) Ham? (\textbf{o fiambre}.) Juice? (\textbf{o sumo}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Free time and nature — a second pass}

\label{lesson:PT-R113-second-pass-free-time-and-nature}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a peach and jam.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a peach, jam, a walnut, pepper, a planet
  \item a nurse, a cook, a waiter; an employee, a farmer, a baker
  \item a driver, a lawyer, an engineer, a firefighter, a postman
  \item a customer, a boss, a class, a lesson, an exam
  \item a word, a board; a painting, a rubber, homework, a problem
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A peach? (\textbf{o pêssego}.) Jam? (\textbf{a compota}.) A walnut? (\textbf{a noz}.) Pepper? (\textbf{a pimenta}.) A planet? (\textbf{o planeta}.) A nurse? (\textbf{a enfermeira}.) A cook? (\textbf{o cozinheiro}.) A waiter; an employee? (\textbf{o empregado}.) A farmer? (\textbf{o agricultor}.) A baker? (\textbf{o padeiro}.) A driver? (\textbf{o motorista}.) A lawyer? (\textbf{o advogado}.) An engineer? (\textbf{o engenheiro}.) A firefighter? (\textbf{o bombeiro}.) A postman? (\textbf{o carteiro}.) A customer? (\textbf{o cliente}.) A boss? (\textbf{o chefe}.) A class? (\textbf{a turma}.) A lesson? (\textbf{a aula}.) An exam? (\textbf{o exame}.) A word? (\textbf{a palavra}.) A board; a painting? (\textbf{o quadro}.) A rubber? (\textbf{a borracha}.) Homework? (\textbf{os trabalhos de casa}.) A problem? (\textbf{o problema}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
